[EN] I can't be bothered. Jax's business, not yours.
[ES] No me molestes. Es negocio de Jax, no tuyo.

[EN] You wouldn't think we'd be so profitable out here in Cutthroat Harbor, and yet business is booming.
[ES] No pensarías que seríamos tan rentables aquí en Cutthroat Harbor, y sin embargo el negocio va viento en popa.

[EN] You ever think about starting a business for yourself? Not me! Jax takes good care of us.
[ES] ¿Alguna vez has pensado en iniciar tu propio negocio? ¡Yo no! Jax nos cuida muy bien.
